senses.gloss: जटायु jaṭā-yu, ˚स् -s, m. N. of a fabulous 🞄vulture slain by Rāvaṇa while endeavouring 🞄to rescue Sitā.

जटाल jaṭā-la, a. wearing braided locks;
 🞄filled with, full of (—˚).
जटावल्कलिन् jaṭā-valkalin, a. wearing 🞄braided locks and a garment of bark.
जटिलीकृ jaṭilī-kṛ, fill or cover with.
